cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

Use `uv run python`. Required `.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`; also `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`. Django/aiogram/Celery template; add handlers in `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or routers in `main.py:42`, models in `bot/models.py`, admin in `bot/admin.py`, tasks in `bot/tasks.py` using the `<REDACTED_USER>_task` decorator. Add env vars to `.env.example`; access via `config/settings.py`.
